name: source_line_160
value: TSA estimates this number by using data from the Department of Transportation, U.S. International Air Passenger and Freight Series, https://www.transportation.gov/sites/dot.gov/files/docs/mission/office-policy/aviation-policy/282961/us-international-air-passenger-and-freight-statistics-report-december-2016.pdf.  The last full year of data available is for 2016.  TSA calculates the growth rate of international flights inbound to the United States over the 2014-2016 period and uses that to project the number of flights over the period covered by this collection.
